name: Yakima River Canyon
blurb: Basalt-walled desert canyon between Ellensburg and Yakima — family rafting, blue-ribbon trout, raptors overhead.

sections.notes: Easy current through the canyon. BLM charges a $5 day-use fee ($15 overnight) at its Yakima River Canyon recreation sites, which are open year-round (https://www.blm.gov/visit/yakima-river-canyon-campgrounds).
